When I listen to my big brother's piano, I feel energized.
My song and my big brother's piano come together—
data.card-smr-05-seik-00|obtainMessage:
Big brothers,
I love you all…!
data.card-smr-05-xmas-00|description:
All of you are my Santa Claus!
Your smiles are the best Christmas present!
So from me, with gratitude on this holy night,
I'll deliver a wonderful time to you
data.card-smr-05-xmas-00|obtainMessage:
Here's a Christmas present
from me to all of you!
data.card-suz-02-eve-01|description: All that's left now is to wait!
data.card-suz-02-eve-02|description:
I can't wait to see what expressions everyone makes
when they eat this. Fufufu…
data.card-suz-02-eve-02|name: Add Some Spice to the Osechi, too!
data.card-suz-04-casl-00|description: You may adore me e~ven more, you know!
data.card-suz-05-alic-00|description:
The rabbit has jumped into the hole!
This has the makings of a grand adventure. We shall chase after it too!
data.card-suz-05-angl-00|description:
Why is it that the more you're told not to eat it,
the more delicious it becomes……?
data.card-suz-05-angl-00|obtainMessage: If you eat it... you'll be able to fly, you know?
data.card-suz-05-anml-00|description:
You're quite good, aren't you?
I suppose I could make you my personal photographer.
Burn the polished beauty of photogenic Suzu Narumiya
firmly into your eyes.
data.card-suz-05-anml-00|obtainMessage:
Etch the photogenic Suzu Narumiya
into your eyes!
data.card-suz-05-birt-00|description:
Today I received so many blessings from everyone.
With this momentum, I... Suzu Narumiya...
will take over the idol world!
data.card-suz-05-birt-00|obtainMessage: Suzu Narumiya's birthday celebration, let it begin~!
data.card-suz-05-birt-01|description:
A demon with an iron club, Suzu Narumiya with Kyoto dialect!
I'll climb to even greater heights...!
data.card-suz-05-birt-01|obtainMessage: I'm not that childish, you know!
data.card-suz-05-birt-02|description:
Amazing! They're raining down in huge amounts~!
Now I'll never, ever run out of potato chips~!
data.card-suz-05-birt-02|obtainMessage:
The star of today,
Lady Suzu Narumiya has returned~!
data.card-suz-05-birt-03|description:
I will keep shining from now on, together with my irreplaceable loved ones
bright enough that even you can see it
data.card-suz-05-birt-03|obtainMessage:
Mana-sama,
thank you so much
for becoming an idol.
data.card-suz-05-casl-04|description:
…W-Well then, I shall take your feelings into account
and act spoiled as your "equal Lady"
data.card-suz-05-casl-04|obtainMessage:
So fluffy,
so plush,
I just can't get enough~!
data.card-suz-05-fest-02|description:
Just as you lit my way
I'll light yours too
So you'll never wander alone again
data.card-suz-05-fest-02|obtainMessage:
The one who can put the most feeling
into that song—
is none other than me.
data.card-suz-05-goch-00|description:
Merry Christmas! Please accept this gift
packed full of coffee-colored happiness!
data.card-suz-05-goch-00|obtainMessage: Drinking coffee reminds me of it, doesn't it...
data.card-suz-05-idol-00|description:
Today, to repay that loyalty, I'll make it a live that has you thinking: "Tsuki no Tempest—
no, the whole idol industry—has Suzu Narumiya!"
I'll give you a show that makes you feel exactly that!
data.card-suz-05-idol-00|obtainMessage:
I am the center of Tsuki no Tempest,
Suzu Narumiya!
data.card-suz-05-kion-00|description:
When I reluctantly put on cat ears,
everyone started fussing, going 'cute, cute'...
data.card-suz-05-kion-00|obtainMessage:
I don't want you to hug me, nya!
Please let me go, nya~n!
data.card-suz-05-link-00|description:
No matter what happens, Mei will always be my friend,
so I'd love for us to go play together again.
data.card-suz-05-link-00|obtainMessage:
W-why is Mei's car
so fast!?
data.card-suz-05-mizg-01|description:
Let's show off the cuteness of the swim ring more...
How about a pose like this?
Now then, please capture my elegant swim-ring look
properly in your lens
data.card-suz-05-mizg-01|obtainMessage:
When Suzu Narumiya decides to do something,
she makes it happen!
data.card-suz-05-msic-00|description:
Please… let it reach everyone, and Lady Mana
"Stardust Campanella"!
data.card-suz-05-msic-00|name: Dream Sworn on a Starry Night
data.card-suz-05-msic-00|obtainMessage:
I pray... that it reaches everyone,
and reaches Mana-sama
data.card-suz-05-onep-00|description:
*sniff*, I……was able to deliver Mana-sama's song……
to everyone across the country……
To think a day like this would come……
Truly, everyone, thank you, so much……
data.card-suz-05-pair-00|description:
Mei? Why are you patting my head!?
"So cute~" and all, I am not a dog~!
data.card-suz-05-pair-00|obtainMessage: Really, Mei is quite a handful, isn't she
data.card-suz-05-prem-01|description:
So that you can be proud
of having served as my manager,
I, Suzu Narumiya, will return
to being Tsuki no Tempest's center.
And I will definitely stand at the top of the idol world!
data.card-suz-05-prem-01|obtainMessage:
The rain has let up,
it's time for the moon to shine!
data.card-suz-05-seik-00|description:
I remembered back then
that I just have to play the role with all my might, and...
the backstory for that girl I came up with myself
And then, I could act naturally
data.card-suz-05-seik-00|obtainMessage:
I can do this,
the image of the role has completely come to me
data.card-suz-05-wedd-00|description:
Today I am a bride shining pure white like a twinkling star—
the happiest bride in the world!
data.card-suz-05-wedd-00|obtainMessage:
Let us go together!
The two of us shall ring the bell of love!
data.card-suz-05-xmas-00|description:
All you good little children～!
Idol Santa Suzu Narumiya has come to town～!
The idol Santa who swooped down on this starry town
is here to deliver happiness～!
data.card-suz-05-xmas-00|obtainMessage:
Idol Santa Suzu Narumiya
has come to town~!
data.card-szk-02-eve-01|description:
Many pieces gather together and become bonds
"Come gather round my finger" is the symbol of that…
data.card-szk-02-eve-03|description:
I'm... glad I became an idol...
I'm glad I got to connect with everyone...
data.card-szk-02-eve-04|description:
24 centimeters! By the way, my heels are smaller than average,
but my toes are wide, and dancing has developed my arches
data.card-szk-02-mizg-01|description: I'm always working hard, so once in a while... it's okay, right?
data.card-szk-03-schl-00|description: Ugh… being an idol is rough…
data.card-szk-04-casl-00|description: I want to... someday, shine like that too
data.card-szk-05-alic-00|description:
Being an idol has made me more outgoing.
Big sis... I want you to see me as I am now.
data.card-szk-05-alic-00|name: Purring Kitty on the Great Tree
data.card-szk-05-alic-00|obtainMessage:
I want Big Sis
to see me as I am now
data.card-szk-05-angl-00|description:
I'll keep on spreading my wings... together with everyone...
Right now, the droplets are bursting...!
data.card-szk-05-angl-00|obtainMessage: Right now, the droplets are bursting……!
data.card-szk-05-birt-00|description:
I hope these feelings reach everyone who read the article.
Idols really are the best...!
data.card-szk-05-birt-00|obtainMessage:
I want to keep cheering a lot,
and if you don't mind, I'd love your support…!
data.card-szk-05-birt-01|description:
I'm so happy too...
It's become an unforgettable, special day...
data.card-szk-05-birt-01|obtainMessage:
When they call me "Shizuku-han",
my heart races...
The Kyoto dialect is violence-level cute...
data.card-szk-05-birt-02|description:
This birthday is so lively, more than I could ever have imagined back then…
…fufu, maybe I'll brag to Big Sis about it later
data.card-szk-05-birt-02|obtainMessage: Maybe I'll go brag to my big sis later
data.card-szk-05-casl-04|description:
Look forward to it.
This time I'll reel in a big catch
One bigger than anyone's ever seen……!
data.card-szk-05-casl-04|name: A Holiday of Sea Breeze and Memories
data.card-szk-05-casl-04|obtainMessage:
This is a big catch.
Getting this on the first try is a good omen...!
data.card-szk-05-chna-00|description:
People around me always told me someone like me
could never become an idol…
But now, I've become an idol…
I'm standing on the same stage as everyone in SaniP…
data.card-szk-05-goch-00|description:
The Christmas live itself was super fun, but
meeting Cocoa-chan and Chino-chan...
helping out at the shop, practicing together, and having you
perform at the live... all of it, every bit, are good memories.
data.card-szk-05-goch-00|obtainMessage: Being sandwiched between two cute girls, what a lucky break
data.card-szk-05-idol-00|description:
Usually, I was on the side waving the lights...
I didn't know, but... it was truly............beautiful
The waves of light... during my solo part
It kept... wrapping me up the whole time...
data.card-szk-05-idol-00|obtainMessage:
Waves of light…
Keep…wrapping around me…forever…
data.card-szk-05-link-00|description:
Thanks to Chisa-chan, my awkward, tongue-tied youth
is shining.
Thank you, Chisa-chan.
data.card-szk-05-link-00|obtainMessage:
In my youth,
Chisa-chan was always
there beside me.
data.card-szk-05-mizg-03|description:
The city sounds I usually hear... I can't hear a thing
All I hear is the sound of waves, the creak of the swing,
and the rustle of the trees...
data.card-szk-05-mizg-03|obtainMessage:
All I can hear
are the waves
and the whisper of the trees...
data.card-szk-05-pajm-00|description:
Everyone's especially… cute today…!
We're not on stage anymore, so I can take… unlimited photos…!
Their fan service is so generous… the best event…!
It's too precious, I'm taking tons of photos with Satomi-san…!
data.card-szk-05-prem-00|description:
Everyone……has such a totally different vibe from usual……
so very cute……
A rare hairstyle that sends otaku into pure joy……
Utter gratitude to the staff……
data.card-szk-05-prem-00|obtainMessage:
Today, we're... a bit different...!
a.k.a. Sunny Pop... arriving...?
data.card-szk-05-prem-01|description:
I was nervous, but I'm so glad I worked up the courage to invite her.
I hope I can get even closer to Rui-san this year too…!
data.card-szk-05-prem-01|obtainMessage:
Y-yes,
let's hold hands so we don't get separated
data.card-szk-05-rock-00|description:
Without showing a smile... pouring in my feelings...
Cooler still, sharpening the coolness within me...
With confidence, chest out, facing forward.
Today I am... the coolest idol in the world...!
data.card-szk-05-rock-00|obtainMessage:
Today, I'm…
the coolest idol in the world…!
data.card-szk-05-sail-00|description:
I'm glad the location was Okinawa... today the temperature's high
and the sunlight's warm, so it's really nice...
data.card-szk-05-sail-00|obtainMessage:
The singing, dancing idol angler,
Shizuku Hyodo, at your service
data.card-szk-05-snro-00|description:
When I hold Cinnamon-kun's fluffy paw,
my heart settles down.
data.card-szk-05-snro-00|obtainMessage:
Cinnamoroll's little paws,
are so fluffy!
data.card-szk-05-yukt-00|description:
Huh... my face feels kind of hot...
But... it's not... unpleasant...
This fluttering is different from when I said I'd wear a yukata...
data.card-szk-05-yukt-00|obtainMessage: Huh, my face... it's kind of hot...
data.card-szk-05-yuru-00|description:
To me, who was just an idol otaku…
Rui-san showed me a new dream…
Now it's my turn to show everyone a dream…
Together with Rui-san, just the two of us…
data.card-szk-05-yuru-00|obtainMessage: I wonder if I've become someone's object of admiration too
data.card-ymk-05-miku-01|description:
You thought of all sorts of things and cooperated
to liven up Hokkaido's winter, and I was so happy
data.card-ymk-05-miku-01|obtainMessage: Live shows really are fun, aren't they.
data.card-yo-05-sush-00|description:
I'm really glad I got to do a live with SaniP.
But… becoming friends with Chisa-chan makes me happiest.
data.card-yo-05-sush-00|obtainMessage: Maybe we're actually two of a kind, huh
data.card-yu-02-eve-02|description:
Hang in there! The finish line is right here!
Just a little more!
data.card-yu-02-eve-03|description:
Heeey, wait a sec~… were you even listening?
I said today is a hot pot party with "everyone," remember?
data.card-yu-02-miku-00|description:
This is the best song, where Miku-chan's feelings and our feelings connected!
I hope it reaches all the fans~
data.card-yu-03-schl-00|description: Heave-ho. This much is no problem at all
data.card-yu-04-casl-00|description: You're sure full of energy today~ Where should we go~?
data.card-yu-05-birt-00|description:
Hah… hah… I'm okay now…
I've started to lose the line between reality and delusion…
data.card-yu-05-birt-00|obtainMessage:
If you buy until you pull it, it's basically free...
If your fave comes out, you win!
data.card-yu-05-birt-01|description:
Being able to switch into work mode right away, no matter when,
is what makes a pro. Alright, let's draw up a storm~!
data.card-yu-05-birt-01|obtainMessage:
It pierced deeep
into my heart, I tell ya
data.card-yu-05-birt-02|description:
No no, it doesn't look like me at all! ...Well, I can't quite say that
Do I really come across like this?
data.card-yu-05-birt-02|obtainMessage:
On your birthday, no matter how much you eat,
it's zero calories……?
data.card-yu-05-casl-02|description:
It's the reward event for the big scene, after all!
I'm getting nervous in more ways than one!
data.card-yu-05-casl-04|description:
Fufu... such a close distance, like we're lovers
It became a good memory, thank you
data.card-yu-05-casl-04|name: A Holy Land Holiday Overflowing with Love
data.card-yu-05-casl-04|obtainMessage:
Hehe...
So close, like we're lovers.
data.card-yu-05-chna-00|description:
No good, don't tempt me any more…
any more than this~!
data.card-yu-05-chna-00|obtainMessage:
Happiness like this while I'm on a diet...
Is it really okay for me to have it?
data.card-yu-05-fest-00|description:
To all our fans! To all the staff!
And then――
To you, who've always supported us――
We'll repay you with our song! Watch us to the very end~!
data.card-yu-05-fest-00|obtainMessage:
To you who always support us—
we'll repay you with our songs!
data.card-yu-05-fest-01|description:
I've decided I'll definitely make it there,
to the end of a road nobody knows.
data.card-yu-05-fest-01|obtainMessage:
I couldn't have made it
to a place like this alone
data.card-yu-05-fest-04|description:
Keep believing in us from now on, ya hear!
We're counting on you for a long, long time~!!
data.card-yu-05-fest-04|name: Pure White Wings Bound for a Miracle
data.card-yu-05-fest-04|obtainMessage:
Thanks for showing me
this kind of scenery~
data.card-yu-05-idol-00|description:
I still wanna sing so much more
but it ends in the blink of an eye
But that's all because today's live was so fulfilling, I bet~
It's really all thanks to everyone!
data.card-yu-05-idol-00|obtainMessage:
I had a super
good time today too!
data.card-yu-05-idol-04|description:
Hehe... How do you like my bathing scene?
Is my grown-up charm making your heart race?
data.card-yu-05-idol-04|obtainMessage:
Please shoot me beautifully,
down to every last drop of water.
data.card-yu-05-jwel-00|description:
Fufu, this time it's a musical, so acting goes without saying
I want to cherish the singing, the dancing, and the live feel too—all of it
data.card-yu-05-jwel-00|obtainMessage:
I'll take on the role of the princess,
together with Sumire-chan.
data.card-yu-05-link-00|description:
I really do love Rui-chan after all
Thank you so much, Rui-chan

Photographers praise the model a ton
while shooting gravure, right
You can say way more stuff about me, like 'nice~' 'you're pretty~'
or 'so sexy~', ya know
data.card-yu-05-mizg-01|obtainMessage:
Hehehe, your face is all red~
What're you getting shy about?
data.card-yu-05-mizg-02|description:
Did you notice?
Look, only my costume is a biiit wet.
During the test shoot, a certain hot-shot photographer
said it looks sexier a little wet, so…
data.card-yu-05-mizg-02|obtainMessage:
Look, only my outfit is,
just a tiny～ bit wet

Well then, I'll nurse ya slowly and thoroughly, okay.
This is acting practice too, so come on, come on.
data.card-yu-05-nurs-00|obtainMessage:
Don't you move,
just look at me

Ah, Manager-san. Hurry, hurry, the spot next to me is open, you know?
Fufu, or else... shall I sit on your lap?
data.card-yu-05-ster-00|description:
Ah, my reason is about to melt away... but I'll take it on.
Even if you're a demon, I want us to understand each other, so...
data.card-yu-05-ster-00|obtainMessage:
I'm scheduled to do a musical
together with Rui-chan.
data.card-yu-05-vlnt-00|description:
Oh geez～, I'm such a scatterbrain～
I accidentally left my stuff in a taxi～
...Kidding, of course that's a lie!
data.card-yu-05-vlnt-00|obtainMessage:
Every time Valentine's comes around,
please remember me, okay.
data.card-yu-05-wedd-01|description:
How do I look? Fufu, I'm happy but
guess I'm still a bit embarrassed
Manager-san, am I cute?
Pretty good, wouldn't ya say?
data.card-yu-05-wedd-01|obtainMessage:
Am I cute?
Not bad at all, right?
data.card-yu-05-xmas-00|description:
I'm enjoying the party~
Thank you so much for today
I got the best Christmas present from Manager~
data.card-yu-05-xmas-00|obtainMessage: The three of us in TRINITYAiLE are having fun~
data.card-szk-05-birt-03|description:
Whenever I'm with everyone,
my happy memories just keep growing.
Thank you for always being by my side
data.card-szk-05-birt-03|obtainMessage:
The time I spend with everyone
is the greatest present of all
